sections.overview:
Telegram-Marketing-Toolkit is a comprehensive marketing and automation solution offering 43+ functions for Telegram-based campaigns. The toolkit includes core features such as member management through the member adder, audience research via scraper capabilities, direct messaging at scale through mass DM functionality, and message distribution via forwarder tools. Additional capabilities include reporting, API ID creation, and other automation functions designed to streamline Telegram marketing workflows.
Add members to Telegram groups and channels at scale for audience growth
Scrape Telegram user data and group information for market research and targeting
Send mass direct messages to multiple Telegram users for promotional campaigns
Forward messages across multiple Telegram channels and groups simultaneously
